# Audio To Text Transcription

> Chrome extension that converts audio and video to text, powered by AI. Upload files or record from microphone/browser tab. Transcription runs in the background, with an email notification when the transcript is ready. Includes a free plan and supports 90+ transcription languages. Edit transcripts, copy text, or download as TXT.

## Product
- [Homepage](https://audio-to-text-transcription.com/): Features, how it works, FAQ, and demo
- [Chrome Web Store listing](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/audio-to-text-transcription/pkfoaaglghblmjjjpbniicjcpehfbmgd): Install the extension

## Pricing and subscriptions
- [Plans and current prices](https://audio-to-text-transcription.com/#pricing): Free, Basic, Pro and Max. Paid plans offer monthly or yearly billing. Yearly cards show a monthly equivalent and the full amount charged for the year.
- [Billing and minute allowances FAQ](https://audio-to-text-transcription.com/#faq): Paid plan minutes reset every 30 days for both billing periods. A yearly payment does not grant all of the year's minutes at once. Covers monthly-to-yearly conversion, Extra Minutes, cancellation and the 14-day money-back guarantee.

Subscriptions apply to the Chrome extension on computers. The website's free transcription demo has separate limits; purchasing a subscription does not increase those demo limits. See the linked pricing section and FAQ for current amounts and conditions.
